import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double min_diff = 1e9;
        long numerator = 0;
        long denominator = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long lcm = gcdLL((long) y, i);
            long ip = (long) (x * (lcm / y));
            long denom = lcm / i;

            if (ip % denom == 0) {
                ip /= denom;
            } else {
                double val = ip;
                double denomDouble = denom;
                val = (val / denomDouble) + 0.49;
                ip = (long) val;
            }

            double ip_double = ip;
            double current_diff = Math.abs(x / y - ip_double / i);
            if (min_diff > current_diff) {
                min_diff = current_diff;
                numerator = ip;
                denominator = i;
            }
        }

        int g = gcdLL(numerator, denominator);
        numerator /= g;
        denominator /= g;

        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
        sc.close();
    }

    private static long gcdLL(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return a;
        return gcdLL(b, a % b);
    }
}
